recent_en: Enest Group Berhad has only routine closed-period dealings disclosures by its CFO recently, with no major corporate activities. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 13.6% QoQ and net profit dropped 40.7% QoQ.
risks_en: The CFO made multiple disclosures of share acquisitions during the closed period.
Both revenue and net profit declined QoQ in the latest quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 36.39 million, down 13.6% QoQ; net profit was MYR 1.207 million, down 40.7% QoQ; net margin fell from 4.8% to 3.3%.
